evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Rep never asked the two-concerns opener about movers not showing up on time or damage to items.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — no concerns were proactively raised by customer at step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep never addressed whether October 18th is a Value Day or offered any alternative date pricing.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never explicitly asked for the business or mentioned rate lock/no deposit. Customer appears to have already booked online; rep confirmed details but did not close with a direct ask.

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details (furniture inventory, box count, building access, floor/elevator information, walking distances) and personalized the estimate downward from 5.25 hours to 3.5-4.5 hours based on what the customer actually had to move.
coaching_note: The two-concerns question (on-time guarantee and damage protection) was never asked, and the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) were never delivered—these are the highest-leverage early-call trust-builders and must come before probing starts; also, no explicit ask for the business or mention of rate lock/no deposit, which should close the call.
